summary: Iter85 review: Client Dashboard V2 (redesign FAZA 4). Frontend-only tests on mobile 390x850 + desktop 1920x1080. All 12 acceptance items validated. Login as client@propmanage.io → /client shows client-dashboard-v2 (V2, NOT classic). Header greeting+bell+badge (50 unread → 49 after mark-read via notifs-sheet). Hero C rendered with real assigned request + CTA 'Plătește avansul (escrow)' → click POST /api/payments/checkout-session (verified via request interception; demo mode auto-redirects with session_id=cs_demo_... — expected). 4 action tiles all present. Contextual v2-ctx-pay + v2-ctx-confirm rendered from real data. Wizard end-to-end: category (disabled→enabled) → title+desc → priority+budget → POST /api/requests → v2-wizard-done → 'Mergi la lucrările mele' navigates to jobs with new TEST_V2_iter85 request visible. Jobs view: chat/timeline/offers actions functional, 'Vezi ofertele' navigates to /client/requests/{id}/offers. Property hub: all 5 items (twin, health, timeline, wallet, manage). Wallet shows real user.wallet_balance=5000.00 RON + 4 topup presets. Settings: 2FA modal opens; legacy switch → dashboard classic + floating switch-to-v2-btn → back to V2 works. Regression /dashboard/client-junior + /dashboard/client-v2 (mockup) both load without ErrorBoundary. AI action dispatches pm-open-ai window event once. FOUND 1 MOBILE UI OVERLAP BUG: WhatsApp float button covers v2-nav-settings tab on 390x850.

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile 390x850, the fixed floating WhatsApp CTA (data-testid=whatsapp-float-btn, size 56x56 at x=318,y=778) overlaps directly on top of the last bottom-nav item 'Setări' (v2-nav-settings, box x=312,y=790.5 w=78 h=59.5). elementFromPoint returns the WhatsApp <A> tag, so a real user tap on 'Setări' opens WhatsApp instead of Settings tab. Only worked via JS .click() during tests. Bug does NOT reproduce on desktop 1920 (WhatsApp is at x=1840, bottom nav sits inside max-w-md container far from right edge).

issues: WhatsApp bubble ALSO overlaps the FAB 'Solicită' green center button visually (both bottom-right/center area) — cosmetically the whatsapp icon is in the same visual zone as the green FAB and the settings tab. Recommend hiding whatsapp-float-btn OR raising bottom-4 to bottom-24 on mobile when the /client route (V2) is active — mirroring the existing `lg:bottom-24` breakpoint the code already uses. Alternatively, hide the WhatsApp bubble on all /client* routes since we have a dedicated 'Întreabă AI' action tile + FAB.

action_items: HIGH — Fix bottom-nav vs WhatsApp overlap on mobile: on /client (V2) either (a) hide [data-testid=whatsapp-float-btn] when ClientDashboardV2 is mounted, or (b) move whatsapp bubble to `bottom-24 right-4` on small screens (currently `bottom-4 right-4 lg:bottom-24 lg:right-6`) so it clears the bottom nav (bottom-nav is ~60px tall + 20px padding = ~80px). Users cannot access 'Setări' tab on mobile without this fix.

LOW — Timeline/Wallet/Chat sheets do not consistently close on Escape key. RequestTimelineModal + PropertyTimelineModal stayed open across two Escape presses during tests; only the X (v2-sheet-close) reliably closes. Consider adding a keydown listener on document for 'Escape' in the Sheet/Modal shared component.
critical_code_review_comments: ClientDashboardV2.jsx is 230 LOC — good; well split into HomeV2/JobsV2/PropertyHubV2/RequestWizard/ui.jsx.

ClientDashboardV2.jsx L79: useEffect deps only [user] — if user changes reference but is same identity, loadProps/loadRequests/loadNotifs re-run; harmless but a stable-reference `user?.id` dep would be cleaner.

ClientDashboardV2.jsx L47-49: three axios.get chained in .then/.catch — consider Promise.all for parallel; also silent .catch(() => {}) hides API errors from users. Recommend at least console.warn or a toast.

HomeV2.jsx L69: `navigate(/client/requests/{id}/offers)` — this URL is a route belonging to the CLASSIC dashboard sub-tree. Confirmed still works (offers page loads) but consider bringing it under a V2 shell if you plan to sunset legacy.
PropertyHubV2.jsx WalletSheet L11-18: alert() for validation and errors; consider inline error text under the input (a11y + mobile UX).

RequestWizard.jsx L21-29: submit() catches error and shows alert(); after failure the wizard stays on step 3 which is correct — but the CTA text stays 'Trimite cererea' (not disabled) so user could double-tap and create two duplicates. Consider disabling for a debounce window.
ClientDashboardSwitch.jsx: localStorage read at MODULE render — SSR would break if ever added, but that's not the current setup, so OK.

The demo Stripe mode in the backend AUTO-REDIRECTS with payment=success on click — this means the payment CTA test in an automated environment ALWAYS completes the payment (irrespective of the review-request instruction 'don't complete Stripe'). For production Stripe mode this is not a concern; for the demo endpoint used in preview, it is impossible to stop at the checkout URL. Consider whether the demo mode should redirect straight to success or to a fake checkout confirm screen first.

AIConciergeBubble / WhatsAppFloatButton: both float in the bottom-right; on the mobile V2 layout they collide with the BottomNav. Recommend a Route-aware wrapper: hide floating widgets on /client (V2) and /dashboard/client-* routes.

success_rate.frontend: 12/12 acceptance items pass functionally; 1 HIGH UI overlap bug found (Settings tab tap on mobile)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 new request via wizard: TEST_V2_iter85 (category=zugravit, priority=normal, budget=200, property=Skyline Loft A4). It appears in jobs list as status=open. Marked 1 notification as read (unread went 50→49). Also, the hero-C payment CTA test fired a POST /api/payments/checkout-session for the currently-assigned test request (backend was in demo mode so this auto-completed to a paid escrow — noted for main agent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: V2 client dashboard is functionally complete. Only blocker on mobile is the WhatsApp float overlapping BottomNav 'Setări'. The Settings tab is UNREACHABLE via real tap on 390x850 — reproduced via elementFromPoint returning the whatsapp-float-btn <A>. Desktop 1920 unaffected. To reproduce: login client → viewport 390x850 → attempt to click v2-nav-settings — action goes to WhatsApp instead. Legacy switch + return-to-v2 works. Wizard flow creates real /api/requests entries. Payment CTA POSTs to /api/payments/checkout-session; in demo mode the URL redirects with session_id=cs_demo_*, which triggers ClientDashboardV2's poll for /api/payments/status/{id} — successful path was observed. Notifications: badge shows count of !n.read; clicking a notif POSTs /api/notifications/{id}/read.
rca_of_the_issue: BUG: 'Setări' bottom-nav tab unclickable on mobile. Reproduction: (1) login as client@propmanage.io, viewport 390x850, (2) on /client tap on the gear icon at bottom-right of bottom nav. Expected: settings view opens. Actual: nothing happens (WhatsApp link opens in new tab). Root cause: [data-testid=whatsapp-float-btn] uses Tailwind `fixed bottom-4 right-4 lg:bottom-24 lg:right-6 z-40` and BottomNav uses `fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-40`. Same z-index but the WhatsApp element is later in DOM order → it wins hit-testing. On mobile the whatsapp box (bottom:4px, right:4px, w=56, h=56) lands at approximately x=318..374, y=778..834 which is INSIDE the last cell of the 5-column bottom-nav grid (last cell x=312..390, y=790..850). Fix (recommend one): in AIConciergeBubble.jsx (or wherever WhatsAppFloatButton lives), change positioning to `bottom-20 right-4 lg:bottom-24 lg:right-6` so on mobile it sits above the bottom nav; OR gate rendering with `if (location.pathname.startsWith('/client')) return null;` to hide the widget on V2 client area (dedicated AI action tile + FAB already cover the same need).
